decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, CompX presents combined basic and diluted EPS and weighted-average common shares. Share counts are presented in thousands and tagged with scale three; per-share amounts use scale zero. These pages retain the encoded counts without adding the basic and diluted denominators. The combined presentation does not establish why the measures match or prove that no potentially dilutive securities exist.

paragraph_requires: (In thousands, except share and per share amounts)
Since the Company is in a net loss position for all periods presented, all potentially dilutive securities are considered anti-dilutive
decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, Plug Power excludes all potentially dilutive securities from diluted EPS because it reports losses. The numerator is loss attributable to Plug Power after noncontrolling interests, rather than the consolidated net loss before that allocation. Shares and per-share amounts are exempt from the statement’s thousands heading. The reported EPS and weighted-average counts remain unchanged; excluded potential shares are not added to the denominator.

table_requires: Net loss attributable to Agenus Inc. common stockholders
paragraph_requires: (Amounts in thousands, except per share amounts)
including common shares issuable under our Directors’ Deferred Compensation Plan
All common share, per share and related information included in the accompanying financial statements and footnote disclosures have been adjusted retroactively
decisions.reader_note: For 2023–2025, Agenus includes common shares issuable under its directors’ deferred-compensation plan in basic EPS. Other potential dilution is excluded because the common-stockholder result is a loss. The numerator reflects preferred dividends and noncontrolling interests. Reported 2025 EPS rounds to zero despite a common-stockholder loss; zero EPS does not mean break-even. The share counts are presented in thousands and tagged with scale three. The filing already adjusts applicable share and per-share information for the 2024 one-for-twenty reverse split; no second adjustment is applied.
